name: noren-mcp

tools.name: noren_gateway_stats
tools.description: Live gateway statistics: how many paid APIs, 402 challenges, and settled USDG payments on Robinhood Chain (eip155:4663), read from the gateway.

tools.name: noren_list_apis
tools.description: List the pay-per-call APIs the gateway sells, with their path and price in USDG. Use a slug from this list with noren_payment_request (hosted, you sign) or noren_pay_call (local, with your own key).

tools.name: noren_reputation
tools.description: Reputation of an EVM wallet computed only from payments that settled on Robinhood Chain: score, tier, settled count, total USDG and the transaction hashes behind it.

tools.name: noren_leaderboard
tools.description: Top paying wallets by settled count, from the gateway leaderboard.

tools.name: noren_verify_payment
tools.description: Check a payment on Robinhood Chain directly from the chain RPC: whether the transaction succeeded and the USDG Transfer events it contains. Does not trust the gateway.

tools.name: noren_check_counterparty
tools.description: Guard: check a wallet before you pay it or buy from it. Combines the gateway reputation (payments settled through Noren) with the wallet's native ETH balance and transaction count read from the Robinhood Chain RPC. Returns a verdict: known_good = at least 5 settled payments AND score >= 40; limited_history = 1 to 4 settled payments; unknown = no settled payments recorded. Read only. The verdict reflects only payments settled through the Noren gateway and is not a guarantee. Related: noren_reputation.

tools.name: noren_payment_request
tools.description: Step 1 of paying for an API from a hosted agent without sharing a key. Give an API slug and YOUR wallet address; returns the exact price, whether your wallet must first approve USDG (with the ready-to-send approve transaction) and the EIP-712 typed data for your wallet to sign. Nothing is spent and the server never sees a key. Then sign the typed data locally and call noren_submit_payment.

tools.name: noren_submit_payment
tools.description: Step 2: send the signed payment. Pass the slug, the intent object returned by noren_payment_request (unchanged) and the signature your wallet produced. The gateway settles USDG on Robinhood Chain and returns the API result and the settlement transaction. Fails with a clear reason if the intent was altered, expired, unfunded or not approved.

signature.description: EIP-712 signature of the typed data

tools.name: noren_pay_call
tools.description: Call one paid gateway API and pay for it in USDG over x402 on Robinhood Chain. The price comes from the gateway list, never from arguments. Requires NOREN_PAYER_KEY in the client environment, a per-call cap (NOREN_MAX_USDG_PER_CALL) and a daily cap (NOREN_MAX_USDG_PER_DAY). Returns the API result and the settlement transaction.

annotations.title: Pay for an API call (local key)

instructions:
Noren sells pay-per-call APIs in USDG on Robinhood Chain (eip155:4663) over x402.
Read tools: noren_list_apis, noren_gateway_stats, noren_reputation, noren_leaderboard, noren_verify_payment (checks the chain directly).
Guard: call noren_check_counterparty before paying an unfamiliar wallet or API seller and tell the user the verdict and its caveat.
To pay: noren_payment_request (spends nothing) -> wallet signs typedData -> noren_submit_payment. Tell the user the price and get a yes first. Never ask for or send a private key.
noren_pay_call exists only on a local stdio server with caps set by the user.
Resources: noren://apis, noren://stats, noren://wallet/{address}. Prompts: buy_api, check_before_paying.
